effects.label: Terms
effects.text: After your Terms are accepted and the Proposal's Accepted effect applies, you may place this card from your Hand as an Overlay on the contested Territory without spending an Action. Each player still there withdraws. Neither player may enter this Territory during the turn this card is placed. To enter it while no Player Token is there, discard one card. It cannot be captured or change control while this card remains. At the start of the placing player's turn, before the Capture step, if their Player Token is there, they discard one card or withdraw. After the next battle fought here, put this card in its owner's Discard Pile.

effects.label: Terms
effects.text: When you offer Terms, you may reveal this card from your Hand and offer two eligible Proposals with the same Stake instead of one. Stake that amount once.

effects.label: Accepted
effects.text: The opponent chooses which Proposal is accepted.

effects.label: Refused
effects.text: Choose one Proposal before applying its Refused effect. Only it may be imposed. The other Proposal does not take effect or become ratified. After the Terms conclude, put this card in your Discard Pile.

effects.label: Action
effects.text: Bank this card.

effects.label: Activate
effects.text: When you offer Terms, before the opponent accepts or refuses, you may discard this card to draw one card, then reveal one card from your Hand and set it aside.

effects.label: Accepted
effects.text: Put that card in your Graveyard, then gain 1 Influence.

effects.label: Refused
effects.text: Return it to your Hand before Gambits are set.

effects.label: Accepted
effects.text:
If the Proposal is unratified, the opponent chooses one before ratification:

- Ratify it normally.
- Leave it unratified; you gain 2 Influence. After the accepted Terms conclude, put this card in your Discard Pile, then draw one card.

effects.label: Refused
effects.text: Put this card in your Discard Pile, then draw one card before Gambits are set.

effects.label: Action

effects.label: Activate
effects.text: When you would lose a battle following refused Terms, you may discard this card to withdraw instead. The opponent remains at or takes the contested position. The battle ends without a winner.

effects.label: Text
effects.text:
In the Aftermath following an opponent's refusal of your Terms, you may place this card from your Hand as an Overlay on a Territory that opponent controls without spending an Action. Identify that opponent and this card's owner.
The first time each turn the identified opponent enters or leaves this Territory, they choose one: discard one card; or the identified owner gains 1 Influence.
Put this card in its owner's Discard Pile after the identified opponent accepts that owner's Terms or loses control of this Territory.

effects.label: Text
effects.text:
After an opponent refuses your Terms, you may bank this card from your Hand without spending an Action. Identify that opponent.
While banked, the first time each turn that opponent plays a card for its Action effect, they choose one: discard one card; or you draw one card.
After that opponent accepts your Terms, put this card in its owner's Discard Pile.

effects.label: Text
effects.text:
After an opponent refuses your Terms, you may bank this card from your Hand without spending an Action. Identify that opponent.
While banked, that opponent's Asset limit is reduced by 1, to a minimum of 0.
After that opponent accepts your Terms, put this card in its owner's Discard Pile.
